notes.scope: Named loot chest variants with a supported access route and distinct loot pool. The unofficial Big, Red Chest placeholder is excluded.
notes.rosterPolicy: The 18-row Roblox Den roster is reconciled with the current Corrupted Chest documented by the community wiki and Pro Game Guides.
notes.valuePolicy: Loot chances, exact spawn chances, and unstable refresh timing are omitted. Duplicate loot values are collapsed.
notes.availabilityPolicy: Conditional routes are described by biome, encounter, crafting, or Hard Mode access rather than as temporary live events.

item.name: Common Chest
item.spawnCondition: Appears in map areas opened by Campfire level 2.
item.cardSummary: An early exploration chest with basic tools, supplies, seeds, weapons, fuel, and a possible Diamond.

item.name: Good Chest
item.spawnCondition: Appears from Campfire levels 2 and 3 and becomes more common farther from camp.
item.cardSummary: A common step above the starter chest, adding Leather Body and Berry Seeds to familiar early-run gear.

item.name: Iron Chest
item.spawnCondition: Appears mainly in deeper areas opened by Campfire levels 3 and 4.
item.cardSummary: A deeper-map chest that can upgrade a run with a Rifle, Strong Flashlight, armor, and defensive supplies.

item.name: Legendary Chest
item.spawnCondition: Can appear in normal chest locations and becomes more common in areas opened by Campfire level 5.
item.cardSummary: A rarer progression chest with stronger storage, armor, healing, fuel, seeds, and a Bear Trap.

item.name: Gold Chest
item.spawnCondition: Appears most often in the deepest map areas reached with a maxed Campfire, with rare spawns closer to camp.
item.cardSummary: A late-map chest with strong utility gear, defenses, fuel, weapons, and high-value progression gems.

item.name: Ruby Chest
item.spawnCondition: Can appear very rarely at normal chest locations and is guaranteed after clearing the Cultist Stronghold.
item.accessRequirement: Clear the Cultist Stronghold for a guaranteed chest.
item.specialBehavior: After one player opens it, the chest becomes a Gold Chest for other players.
item.cardSummary: A very rare chest and stronghold reward with top-end weapons, Thorn Body, Riot Shield, and a progression fragment.

item.name: Diamond Chest
item.spawnCondition: Appears after the enemies in the Cultist Stronghold are cleared.
item.specialBehavior: Returns when the Cultist Stronghold refreshes.
item.cardSummary: A Cultist Stronghold reward chest that always gives Diamonds instead of a mixed item pool.

item.name: Alien Chest
item.spawnCondition: Appears at the end of the Mothership route when the Alien encounter is available in a run.
item.accessRequirement: Find a crashed UFO with a Mothership portal, then clear the enemies inside.
item.cardSummary: The Mothership reward chest, holding Alien Tech weapons or Alien Armor after the hallway fights.

item.name: Ice Chest
item.spawnCondition: Appears in specific points of interest when the Snow Biome is present.
item.accessRequirement: Break the ice around the chest with an axe before opening it.
item.cardSummary: A Snow Biome chest with frozen weapons and utility loot, sealed inside breakable ice.

item.name: Cold Chest
item.spawnCondition: Appears in structures across the Snow Biome.
item.accessRequirement: Break the ice around the chest before opening it.
item.cardSummary: A common Snow Biome route chest with cold gear, basic armor, fuel, and a possible Diamond.

item.name: Hot Chest
item.spawnCondition: Appears around the Volcanic Biome when that biome is present.
item.cardSummary: A Volcanic Biome chest with fire-route weapons, traps, armor, and ranged gear.

item.name: Infernal Chest
item.spawnCondition: Appears at fixed Volcanic Biome route stops.
item.accessRequirement: Reach the church roof by parkour or search The Furnace.
item.specialBehavior: Loot from the church-roof chest can fall into lava after it is opened.
item.cardSummary: A Volcanic Biome route chest with Infernal weapons or an Infernal Sack at two dangerous structures.

item.name: Vine Chest
item.spawnCondition: Appears in trap-filled temples when the Jungle Biome is present.
item.accessRequirement: Navigate the temple traps and underground routes.
item.cardSummary: A Jungle temple chest mixing poison weapons with practical exploration and healing gear.

item.name: Jungle Chest
item.spawnCondition: Appears below the Mother Temple when the Jungle Biome route is present.
item.accessRequirement: Collect four crystal skulls to open the Mother Temple basement.
item.cardSummary: The Mother Temple basement chest, reached with crystal skulls and focused on Poison gear.

item.name: Frog Chest
item.spawnCondition: Appears through the Frog Cave route when the Frog encounter is available.
item.accessRequirement: Fish up eight Frog Keys to enter, then clear the cave's enemy waves.
item.cardSummary: A Frog Cave reward chest with poison gear and Frog Boots after the key hunt and combat waves.

item.name: Obsidiron Chest
item.spawnCondition: Must be crafted during the Meteor route instead of found on the map.
item.accessRequirement: Craft its blueprint at the Meteor Tool Workshop with 10 Meteor Shards, 5 Gold Shards, and 3 Obsidiron Ingots, then place it at base.
item.specialBehavior: This chest is created and placed by players rather than opened at a map spawn.
item.cardSummary: A player-crafted Meteor route chest that produces an Obsidiron Hammer or Obsidiron Body.

item.name: Spooky Chest
item.spawnCondition: Appears in the Hedge Maze when the Carnival route is available.
item.accessRequirement: Win three Carnival minigames and use the tickets to enter the Hedge Maze.
item.specialBehavior: Candies are part of the pool only when the Halloween content is active.
item.cardSummary: A Hedge Maze dead-end chest with food and potion rewards after the Carnival entry challenge.

item.name: Vampire Chest
item.spawnCondition: Appears at the end of the Hedge Maze when the Carnival route is available.
item.accessRequirement: Enter the Hedge Maze and reach its end.
item.cardSummary: The Hedge Maze finish chest, offering Vampire weapons or the Vampire Cloak.

item.name: Corrupted Chest
item.spawnCondition: Appears after Hard Mode is activated.
item.accessRequirement: Activate Hard Mode and follow its corruption route.
item.cardSummary: A Hard Mode chest that supplies the corrupted weapon family and Corrupted Armour.
